Tests batch URI extraction API (extract_batch)

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind, extractBatch } from "@xberg-io/xberg";
async function main() {
  const result = await extractBatch([{ kind: ExtractInputKind.Uri, uri: "https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf" } as ExtractInput]);
  console.log(result.results?.[0]?.mimeType);
  console.log(result.results?.[0]?.content);
}
```
